_comment: Crank. "At the start of your turn, destroy this UNLESS you remove a steam counter from it" — mutually exclusive, but the JSON ran DESTROY_PERMANENT and REMOVE_COUNTER unconditionally, so it destroyed itself every turn AND spent the counter. Now a PAY_OR_ELSE whose cost is the counter. STILL SIMPLIFIED: the activated ability's "Mechanologist item OF THE SAME COLOR" is hardcoded yellow, and its nested filter uses singular subtype/class keys that CARD_IN_ZONE does not read (it reads filter_types / card_class), so that search filter is inert. The 'put it on top of your deck' step was a nested PUT_TOP_DECK, which is not an effect type -- lazily compiled, so it raised ValueError whenever the ability was activated rather than failing at load. SEARCH_BANISH_FACE_DOWN already takes the destination, so it says deck_top directly.

abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, so the counters were never placed. 'Enters the arena with N counters' happens ONCE, when it enters -- an ON_ENTER_PLAY trigger, not a continuous static, which would have kept adding counters had it run at all.
